proposal: Treatment is needed: 2 x 100 % centrifugal separators with water washing. Not in our price (the tender was based on on-spec fuel): EUR 1,900,000.
question: ER-03.07 requires Na+K <= 0.5 mg/kg at the GT inlet; ALP-OWN-FUL-002 says delivered LDO may contain up to 1.0 mg/kg and has reached 1.8 mg/kg. ER-03.09 asks for treatment 'if needed'. Is the Owner's intent that treatment is always included?
response: Rejected. ALP-OWN-FUL-002 was part of the tender documents and states the delivered quality (Na+K up to 1.0 mg/kg, history 1.8 mg/kg). ER-03.09 requires treatment where needed to meet ER-03.07; an experienced contractor would have foreseen the need. No price adjustment.
subject: LDO alkali metals: delivered 1.0 mg/kg (history 1.8) vs 0.5 mg/kg at GT inlet
